I can't check that for you. I don't have access to customer accounts, payment history, or invoices, so I can't see whether a payment went through.

You can see it yourself in the Lumen app under **Settings > Billing**, where your invoices are listed. If you don't see a charge there, or you're not sure about one, email **billing@lumen.io**. The billing team can look up the payment on your account. To help them, include:
- The email address on your account
- The date and amount of the payment
- The invoice number, if you have one
